l.i: istis, Nec senibus cygnis, quando sua funera mæren
Inuideas arguta modos. Te nulla sonora
Quanuis mille gemant media de nocte per alta
Respondet longùm fractas ad sydera Ɛoces:
Nec qua multiplices syrinx argentea cantus
loquaces: Mille licèt geminent centum discrimina Ɛocum
Sed tibi,sed primis semper noua frondibus arbos
Hic ubi lenta suas Loza ludentibus Ɛndis
Miscet,& hinc iuncto Lozanná nomine dicunt.
Iste tuus,mi Beza,tuas qui sæpe camœnas

page.notes: The page is a scan with a left-edge shadow; the italic text is reproduced as far as legible. Several words are uncertain and may contain errors, notably "Ɛna", "Ɛocalis", "Ɛrgens", "Loza" and "Lozanná", which were read approximately. Words such as "Hunc" at the lower right are cut off and marked as the catchword.
